title: internal/runstate's maintenance fixture reads the host's global git maintenance.auto and fails at its own control on hosts that disable auto maintenance
body: TestTheStoresFetchStartsNoMaintenanceInTheRepositoryItWritesTo (internal/runstate/maintenance_test.go) arms a fixture repository's maintenance config (maintenance.loose-objects.enabled=true, autoDetach=false) and then requires that a plain `git fetch` starts a pack, but it never sets `maintenance.auto=true` in the fixture repo. On a host with global `git config maintenance.auto=false` (this workstation: Apple git 2.50.1) the control leg fails 100% of the time — 'a plain `git fetch` in the armed repository started no maintenance; this fixture proves nothing' — so `make test` (the full suite, which every tick's evidence names) can never be green on such a host. Reproduced at the base commit 94a8fe6f with the tick's changes stashed, 3/3 runs, and it is outside this tick's scope (a cloudflare-sandbox/worker harness tick). The likely fix is one `git config maintenance.auto true` in the armed repository: the fixture owns every input of its own control.
